description: For finite symbol sets \(S,T\) in an arbitrary set-sized language \(L\), the union of the ambient translations of theories in \(L\upharpoonright S\) and \(L\upharpoonright T\) is satisfiable exactly when the theories have no separator in \(L\upharpoonright(S\cap T)\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.joint_model_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (S T : Finset L.Symbols)
  (T₁ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage S).Theory)
  (T₂ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportedLanguage T).Theory) :
  ((Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion S).onTheory T₁ ∪
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ChangingLanguages.supportInclusion T).onTheory T₂).IsSatisfiable ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.Inseparable
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.commonLeft S T)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.JointConsistency.commonRight S T) T₁ T₂
